answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the saffron check. Bindings are kept in trellis, verified in walnut, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 73 aliases cost 334 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
